tldr: Birthday memories show a person's photos from past birthdays, three days before each birthday.
goal: Users see photos of people from past birthdays without searching for them.

story.heading: Database adds birthday queries for people and assets
story.body: The repository finds assets taken on each birthday, grouped by year.

story.heading: Memories creates birthday memories for each owner
story.body: The service adds up to 25 assets, newest first, shown three days early.

story.heading: Shared kernel adds birthday data and leap-day rule
story.body: February 29 birthdays use February 28 in years without February 29.

story.heading: Memory data stores the person and birthday year
story.body: Each birthday memory stores personId, personName and the birthday year.

story.heading: Birthday memories reach the API and clients
story.body: The API and SDK expose the new type; web and mobile display it.

components.summary: Handles the birthday memory type and adds its English label.
Reads the birthday memory type during sync and stores it locally.
Regenerates the OpenAPI spec and client with birthday memory data.
Creates birthday memories for each owner, shown three days before.
Adds queries that find birthday people and assets by local date.
Adds birthday memory data to the memory DTO and OpenAPI schema.
Adds the birthday memory type, its data type and the leap-day rule.

decisions.title: Match birthdays on each asset's local date
decisions.why: The query compares the stored local date of each asset with the birthday month and day.

decisions.title: Limit each birthday memory to 25 assets
decisions.why: A birthday memory holds at most 25 assets, with at most 5 assets for each birthday year.
decisions.alternative: Return every asset from every birthday year

decisions.title: Pick one asset per year when over 25 years
decisions.why: Many birthday years give one asset each, picked at random, so the total stays at 25.

decisions.title: Observe leap-day birthdays on February 28
decisions.why: A February 29 birthday shows on February 28 in non-leap years, so no birthday is skipped.

decisions.title: Show birthday memories three days early
decisions.why: Each memory starts three days before the birthday and ends on the birthday.
